ios.desc:
Gem transforms the way you save and organize your favorite discoveries from across the web. Whether you stumble upon a must-try restaurant in an Instagram video or a must-visit landmark on TikTok, Gem simplifies the process of capturing these finds. Just share the content with us, and we'll do the rest—extracting the information and storing it for your future adventures. Our platform is designed to work seamlessly with any social media or content platform, making it easier than ever to organize the places and experiences you want to explore.

Enhanced Features:

Cross-Platform Discovery: Enjoy the freedom to discover on any platform. Found something you love in a video or post? Share it directly to Gem, and we'll extract the details for you.

Effortless Organization: Forget about manual entries. Gem automatically organizes the information extracted from your shared content, categorizing it for easy access and planning.

Tailored to Your Interests: Gem not only stores your finds but also uses them to personalize your recommendations. The more you share, the better Gem gets at suggesting new hidden gems you're bound to love.

Universal Sharing: Whether it's Instagram, TikTok, or any other platform, Gem's universal sharing feature ensures that your discoveries are never more than a share away from being saved and organized.

Your Personalized Discovery Hub: With Gem, your next adventure is always at your fingertips. Our intuitive interface and powerful organization tools make it simple to manage your finds and plan your visits.

Start curating your world with Gem. Discover on any platform, forward the data to us, and we'll organize it for you, ensuring you never lose track of your next must-visit destination. Download Gem today and unlock the full potential of your discoveries.

In app subscriptions:
If you decide to subscribe to Gem Pro, the subscription will be applied to your Apple ID upon confirmation.
Subscriptions will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
You can cancel anytime through the App Store. For more information, please refer to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

Terms of Use: https://gemapp.io/legal/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://gemapp.io/legal/privacy-policy

quotes.text:
I've been discovering a ton of new restaurants, bars, and recipes on Instagram and TikTok. However, I often bookmark them and never see them again. If I really wanted to remember something, I'd open my notes app and write it down, usually after watching the video multiple times to catch all the details. I soon realized that while short videos are great for discovering new things, they aren't very helpful when it comes to taking action.

Even if I remembered saving a post about a new bar, I'd have to sift through all my bookmarked videos to find it. That's why I built Gem.

Gem enhances your discovery process. All you need to do is share the post, and we automatically categorize it and convert it into a proper format, like a list. It's platform-agnostic and works in the background. Think of it as a combination of bookmarking and map functions. Currently, we support saving places (restaurants, bars, cafes, etc.) and recipes on Instagram and TikTok, with movies and TV shows being added soon. The app is straightforward, built quickly in just a few days, but UI updates are on the way.

Gem requires an account. If you'd like to try it: download the app, sign up, find a post on Instagram that features a place or recipe, click share, and then select "Add to Gem."
quotes.title: Show HN: Bookmarking 2.0
